columns.label: how hints name it
columns.setup: where setup's KEYBINDS panel lists it: "foot", "gun", "coop" (every game), "drive" and "light" (the full game only) or "weather" (only where the weather is on offer); none: not listed
columns.help: what the KEYBINDS panel says it does (short)
columns.setupWith: listed on the same KEYBINDS line as that action (its key joined to that one's: "N / B"; that one's help says what both do)

rows.label: G
rows.help: Get in or out (walk up to a pickup)

rows.label: B
rows.about: Previous song while driving (your music: the player's previous track)

rows.label: M
rows.about: Switch the car radio between the Need for Speed stations and your own music (Spotify, a YouTube video, any player in Windows' media controls)
rows.help: Car radio: the stations or your own music

rows.label: J
rows.about: The dash screen: equalizer on / off

rows.label: C
rows.about: Cycle chase / hood / driver camera (NFS Most Wanted PC camera key; unbound in New Vegas)

rows.label: A
rows.about: Live color editor (player controls are off while it runs, so movement keys are free)

rows.label: D
rows.about: Live color editor (player controls are off while it runs, so movement keys are free)

rows.label: W
rows.about: Live color editor (player controls are off while it runs, so movement keys are free)

rows.label: S
rows.about: Live color editor (player controls are off while it runs, so movement keys are free)

rows.label: Left arrow
rows.about: Live color editor (player controls are off while it runs, so movement keys are free)

rows.label: Right arrow
rows.about: Live color editor (player controls are off while it runs, so movement keys are free)

rows.label: Up arrow
rows.about: Live color editor (player controls are off while it runs, so movement keys are free)

rows.label: Down arrow
rows.about: Live color editor (player controls are off while it runs, so movement keys are free)

rows.label: Z
rows.about: Live color editor (player controls are off while it runs, so movement keys are free)

rows.label: X
rows.about: Live color editor (player controls are off while it runs, so movement keys are free)

rows.label: F
rows.about: Live color editor (player controls are off while it runs, so movement keys are free)

rows.label: Enter
rows.about: Live color editor (player controls are off while it runs, so movement keys are free)

rows.label: Backspace
rows.about: Live color editor (player controls are off while it runs, so movement keys are free)

rows.label: F
rows.about: During a burnout: switch between the tyre smoke candidates (while one is being chosen)

rows.label: Page Up
rows.about: Subwoofer up a step (0-10) while driving

rows.label: Page Down
rows.about: Subwoofer down a step (0-10) while driving

rows.label: L
rows.about: Headlights on / off while driving (they come back on as low or high beams, whichever you had)
rows.help: Headlights on / off; high / low beams

rows.label: H
rows.about: High beams / low beams while driving (with the headlights off, turns them on as high beams)

rows.label: Left arrow
rows.about: Holding J: turn the dash screen's picture counter-clockwise half a degree

rows.label: Right arrow
rows.about: Holding J: turn the dash screen's picture clockwise half a degree

rows.label: Up arrow
rows.about: Holding J: slant the dash screen's picture (its uprights lean right at the top) half a degree

rows.label: Down arrow
rows.about: Holding J: slant the dash screen's picture the other way half a degree

rows.label: K
rows.about: Seasons on or off: the weather and the snow on the ground follow the game's calendar (kept in season.ini)

rows.label: V
rows.about: In the car: windshield wipers on or off

rows.label: Y
rows.about: The weather: by the season, or held at clear, overcast, light snow, heavy snow or a blizzard (kept in season.ini)
rows.help: The weather: by the season, or held at one

rows.label: Space
rows.help: At a ledge: vault, mantle or climb; in the air beside a wall: kick off it

rows.label: Shift
rows.help: Hold going forward to sprint; double-tap for a tactical sprint

rows.label: I
rows.about: While driving with friends in the game: offer a ride for 15 s - a friend within about 25 m presses G to get into your passenger seat
rows.help: Driving: offer a friend near you a ride (they press G)

rows.label: Enter
rows.about: Playing together: opens the chat box (JIP LN's text input); /name YourName sets the name friends see

rows.label: O
rows.about: Smooth ADS on or off (the camera easing onto the sights and the gun settling in); saved per game (Mojave Most Wanted / vanilla stable)

rows.label: X
rows.about: Third person: the camera over the other shoulder (also follows a lean round cover to that side)
rows.help: Third person: the camera over the other shoulder

rows.label: F8
rows.about: The feel menu: fine-tune weapon inertia, sway, kick, recoil, camera shake and roll, FOV kick, corner lean speed and the third-person body, live
rows.help: The feel menu: inertia, sway, recoil, camera and body, live

rows.label: F6
rows.about: hosting: let in the player asking to join (their name is on screen)
rows.help: Hosting: let in / turn away the player asking to join

rows.label: F7
rows.about: hosting: refuse the player asking to join (for this session)

rows.label: Insert
rows.about: With RTX Remix in the game (a Remix d3d9.dll in the game folder): its path tracing off and on, live, to compare (rtx.enableRaytracing through the Remix API)
